examples.label: News card with a lead image
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-news" rounded="large" padding="large" space="small" class="max-w-sm">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card-media" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-news-image" src="/images/card-3.jpg" alt="Two people reviewing a page layout on a laptop" rounded="medium" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-news-title" title="Ten minutes to your first landing page" />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-news-body">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small">
      Start from a blank page, drop in a hero, a feature grid and a footer, then publish. No build step and no deploy.
    </.component>
  </.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-card-footer" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-news-footer">
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" color="primary" type="button" size="medium" icon="hero-arrow-right">Read the guide</.component>
  </.component>
</.component>

examples.label: Course card with a cover image and a duration badge
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-card" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-course" rounded="large" padding="large" space="small" class="max-w-md"> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-media" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-course-image" src="/images/card-5.jpg" alt="A notebook and an open terminal on a desk" rounded="medium" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-card-title" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-course-title" position="between"> Ash resources from scratch <.component component_name="chelekom-badge" site="Global" color="info" rounded="full">4h 20m <.component component_name="chelekom-card-content" site="Global" id="showcase-cm-course-body"> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small"> Nine lessons covering actions, policies, relationships and multitenancy, ending with a finished application you can deploy.
